reaction_model.honest_conclusion: Still no candidate beats a flat baseline out of sample, even after adding literature-motivated extensions (winsorizing, volatility standardization, price-level/boundary-compression interaction). The weak pooled correlation does not appear to reflect a stable, generalizable functional relationship in any of the forms tested.
reaction_model.backtest_form_note: No candidate validated on val, so the backtest below uses ols_through_origin (clean, no-intercept sign) rather than the nominal tie-break winner ('ols_intercept'), to avoid an intercept-driven sign artifact.

permutation_test.interpretation: Bonferroni-corrected for 6 total candidate forms compared across both scripts (per Harvey, Liu & Zhu 2016's point that the conventional significance bar is too lax once the number of specifications tried is accounted for). Significant at 0.05 only if bonferroni_corrected_p < 0.05.
